unpack_archive: unpack a tar.gz, tar, or zip archive file to its parent directory
download_url_with_progress: download a file from a URL to a target directory with a tqdm progress bar
download_multiple_urls: download multiple files from a dictionary of URLs to a target directory
quadratic_crop_image: crop a numpy array image to a quadratic region centered on a bounding box
custom_collate_batch: collate a batch of samples into tensors with custom handling for annotations and namedtuples
